claims.complete_count: m * product_p (2*k_p+1)^(degree/2), for the verified principal split primes only
claims.denominator_class_caps_K24: Prime denominators give average degree <=1944; prime-square denominators give <=15000, for any prime and any point selection in a translate of the corresponding module
claims.fixed_CM_upper_bound: M_K(D) <= roots_of_unity(K) * tau(D^2)^(degree/2), for all integer D>=1
claims.full_box_upper_bound: For fixed CM field and fixed integral basis, E <= C_epsilon N^(1+epsilon) uniformly over all denominators and full rectangular boxes
claims.necessary_denominator_growth: In a fixed CM field, a sequence with E >= c*N^(1+delta) for fixed c,delta>0 requires log(D(P-P))/log(N) -> infinity along that sequence
claims.scope: No new record exponent; no impossibility claim for arbitrary selected points or growing fields

comparison_rule: Each row T uses N=T^8 points; coefficient side is T^(8/degree).

scalar_calibration.scope: Large products remain speculative in core and are never used as operands; external exact arithmetic has separate status.
